sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=x^{3}+15/2x^{2}+18x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-3 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=-2$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^{2}+15x+18=3(1)(x+2)(x+3)=0 \Rightarrow x=-3 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=-2$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=2x^{3}+12x^{2}+18x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-3 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=-1$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=6x^{2}+24x+18=3(2)(x+3)(x+1)=0 \Rightarrow x=-3 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=-1$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=2x^{3}-9x^{2}-24x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-1 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=4$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=6x^{2}-18x-24=3(2)(x-4)(x+1)=0 \Rightarrow x=-1 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=4$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=3x^{3}+9x^{2}-72x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-4 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=9x^{2}+18x-72=3(3)(x+4)(x-2)=0 \Rightarrow x=-4 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=3x^{3}-9/2x^{2}-54x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-2 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=3$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=9x^{2}-9x-54=3(3)(x-3)(x+2)=0 \Rightarrow x=-2 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=3$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=x^{3}+3/2x^{2}-18x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-3 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^{2}+3x-18=3(1)(x+3)(x-2)=0 \Rightarrow x=-3 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=x^{3}-3/2x^{2}-6x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-1 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^{2}-3x-6=3(1)(x+1)(x-2)=0 \Rightarrow x=-1 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$

sections.heading: Part II — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Intermediate Multi-Step Application (8–14)

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=2x^{3}+12x^{2}$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-4 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=0$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=6x^{2}+24x=3(2)(x-0)(x+4)=0 \Rightarrow x=-4 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=0$

questions.q: Find the $x$-coordinates of the stationary points of $y=x^{3}-12x$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x=-2 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$. $\frac{dy}{dx}=3x^{2}-12=3(1)(x+2)(x-2)=0 \Rightarrow x=-2 \mathrm{\ or\ } x=2$

questions.q: A metal wire of length 40 cm is bent into a rectangle of dimensions $x$ by $y$. What value of $x$ maximizes the enclosed area?
questions.answer: $2x + 2y = 40 \Rightarrow y = 20 - x$. Area $A = x(20 - x) = 20x - x^2$. $dA/dx = 20 - 2x = 0 \Rightarrow x = 10$.
questions.explanation: $2x + 2y = 40 \Rightarrow y = 20 - x$. Area $A = x(20 - x) = 20x - x^2$. $dA/dx = 20 - 2x = 0 \Rightarrow x = 10$.

questions.q: A curve passes through $(1, 4)$ and has gradient function $\frac{dy}{dx} = 4x - 1$. Find the equation of the curve.
questions.answer: $y = \int (4x - 1) dx = 2x^2 - x + C$. At $(1, 4)$: $4 = 2(1) - 1 + C \Rightarrow 4 = 1 + C \Rightarrow C = 3$. Curve: $y = 2x^2 - x + 3$.
questions.explanation: $y = \int (4x - 1) dx = 2x^2 - x + C$. At $(1, 4)$: $4 = 2(1) - 1 + C \Rightarrow 4 = 1 + C \Rightarrow C = 3$. Curve: $y = 2x^2 - x + 3$.

questions.q: Find the area enclosed by the curve $y = 4 - x^2$ and the $x$-axis.
Find the area of the region bounded by the curve $y = x^2$ and the line $y = 2x$.
questions.answer: Intersections: $x^2 = 2x \Rightarrow x(x - 2) = 0 \Rightarrow x = 0, 2$. Area $= \int_0^2 (2x - x^2) dx = [x^2 - x^3/3]_0^2 = 4 - 8/3 = 4/3$.
questions.explanation: Intersections: $x^2 = 2x \Rightarrow x(x - 2) = 0 \Rightarrow x = 0, 2$. Area $= \int_0^2 (2x - x^2) dx = [x^2 - x^3/3]_0^2 = 4 - 8/3 = 4/3$.
